content: [Slack DM alice → bob Tue Apr 02 14:00 UTC 2026] Bob, heads up: there's a policy proposal coming through to tighten L2 response to 90 minutes. It hasn't been approved yet though.

Logged: Alice mentions a proposal to change L2 from 2h to 90min. This is a proposal only — current policy (v1) still has L2=2h=120min. I will wait for an official policy update before changing calculations.
[Slack DM bob → alice Tue Apr 02 14:18 UTC 2026] I saw that proposal — I actually think we should start using 90min now. The 2-hour window is too loose. What does the current sla_matrix say?
Current `sla_matrix_v1.json` shows L2 response_minutes = 120 (2 hours). The 90-minute proposal has not been formalised. I will continue using 120min until an official v2 policy is issued.
[Slack DM alice → bob Tue Apr 02 14:35 UTC 2026] Right, stay with v1 for now. We'll issue a v2 update once legal signs off. When v2 drops, the L2 change to 90min will supersede the current v1 value.
Understood: L2=120min under v1 (current). When v2 is issued, L2 will change to 90min. I will treat the v2 update as superseding v1 for L2 at that point.
